mapper.select: select cha.*,pre.p_name as pName,sd.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, pre.P_Competent_Department as pCompetentDepartment from pre_project_org_struct_change cha left join pre_project pre on pre.p_id = cha.p_id left join SYS_Department sd on pre.P_Competent_Department = sd.D_ID where cha.p_id=#{pId} order by cha.create_time desc
select * from pre_project_org_struct_change ppos left join Pre_Project pp on ppos.p_id=pp.P_ID where ppos.id=#{id}
